AFTER Revised — 7-step scale · real logo · editorial hero

What changed

Type & readability
1
Collapsed font-size scale. From ~18 ad-hoc sizes to a 7-step scale: xs / sm / base / lg / xl / 2xl / 3xl.
2
Darker body text. --muted #6B7280 → #4B5563. Passes WCAG AA.
3
Two line-heights only. 1.6 for UI, 1.75 for prose.
4
Bigger hero & section titles. Hero up to ~68px; section titles 32 → 36px with tighter tracking.
5
Less uppercase. Only section labels stay uppercase; titles, descriptions, badges lowercased.
6
Letter-spacing dialled in. Labels 2.5 → 1.6px. Headings tightened −1 to −2px.
Logo & brand
7
Real logo integrated. The freshstart wordmark with juice-drip mark now appears in the header, footer, and Instagram avatar.
8
No more duplicate logos. Hero logo-in-a-card replaced with an editorial dark-green panel; logo is reserved for brand anchors only.
Hero & rhythm
9
Hero visual replaced. Dark-green editorial panel with a pull quote, batch stamp, and real numbers (yield + list size).
10
Removed redundant stats. Hero-card stats overlapped with the green strip — consolidated.
11
Hero eyebrow removed. Already said by the stats strip below.
12
Yellow underline under "No Nonsense". Uses brand yellow as a real typographic accent.
Style & surfaces
13
Testimonials decarded. Three columns of editorial typography on cream — quotes carry weight.
14
Radius system, two steps. 10px for UI, 20px for surfaces.
15
Em-dash bullets → real dots. Batch notes use proper green dot markers.
16
Story blockquote. Proper pull quote with a yellow rule instead of left-border accent.
17
Early Access placeholders fixed. White-on-dark contrast 0.4 → 0.62 alpha.
Cleanup
18
Notify-me modal. No more alert() — proper inline success state.
19
Orphaned order-form JS removed. submitOrder() had no form to attach to.
20
Emoji in primary CTA dropped. 🧃 removed from "Get Early Access".
21
Announcement reworded. "Batch 04 drops this month" ties to the batch narrative.
Colors and fonts unchanged. Logo now integrated throughout.
